title: Surreal Cosmic Ascension
description: A surreal painting depicts a woman's face split between golden and blue cosmic textures, wearing an elaborate headdress featuring a black hole surrounded by flowers, bones, and red flames. Below her shoulders, a glowing green staircase ascends into her torso where two silhouetted figures climb, set against a desert landscape with dark ferns, swirling galaxies, auroras, and a green planet in a fiery red-orange sky.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a woman's head and shoulders emerging from sand dunes, her face divided into golden and cosmic blue sides, wearing a massive headdress with a central black hole surrounded by flowers bones and red flame-like feathers, glowing green staircase rising from the desert into her chest where two silhouetted human figures climb, swirling galaxy patterns, dark ferns and plants in foreground, green planet and aurora borealis in a fiery red and orange sky, mystical ethereal atmosphere, highly detailed symbolic surrealism
